Week of August 2

Filed under: #weekly

Hey. It's Sunday so it's week in review time.

Okay. Well, once again, it was a week filled with mostly nothing. My sleep schedule has been getting particularly bad. I go to sleep at like 6 or 7 AM and wake up around 2 PM.

I went to the mall with my mom on Monday and that's the most exciting thing that happened. We weren't there for very long; my mom bought me new clothes (that I don't really need) and new shoes (that don't really fit). I was thinking about returning those shoes though.

School is fast approaching. Oh my god, it's next week. I'm going to stop being a NEET in a week. I can't believe it. I wish I was a NEET forever goddammit. I need to create a yandere BL visual novel and get money funneled into my account (I jest).

I've still been using Obsidian in lieu of Ellipsus (really, in combination with Ellipsus), and I think it works pretty well. I'm currently still using Obsidian as a word processor. It has Markdown, which is great because I use Markdown to post all my posts. (Thank you 11ty. I am so glad I figured you out.)

The only think I dislike about Obsidian is that there's no automatic emdash. I don't think. Is there? If there is, let me know. I don't like having to copy-paste the emdash and I forgot the alt code for it. At least I still have my semicolon and comma.

A lot of people apparently do use Obsidian as a word processor which is interesting. There are also a lot of advanced ways to use Obsidian which is interesting. I don't know. It's all interesting to me.

My goal for this week is to enjoy my final week without school. Smile.
